title: Pantry intake check-in script
brief_markdown:
The community food pantry has one intake desk and a long queue. People arrive tired, and they type in messy ways.

Write one script for the desk. It asks for a person's name, then the service they need, then prints a slip the desk officer can read aloud. Clean both answers first, so the slip looks right however they were typed. The slip's last line sends them to the desk for the service they asked for.

The desk also hands out ticket numbers. A volunteer started the ticket counter for you at the end of `checkin.py`, but it has one bug. Run the script, read the error, and fix the bug without removing the counter. Then add a section to your README, "The error I fixed", that names the error type, the line it pointed to, and what you changed.

When you submit, write a short ownership note in three parts: what you wrote yourself, what a tool or AXIS helped with, and one thing you checked yourself and how.
sample_run: Please wait for the Food Parcel desk.
Please wait for the Shelter desk.
